strategy.title: No plan: the hive-contract price is only something a person said
strategy.why: The only opening (brokered almond-pollination hive contracts) has buyers, a channel, volume (400 growers rent every February), a quoted fulfiller (Valley Apiaries at $110) and measured conversion, but its $150 price is recorded only as a PERSON statement, not evidence. Without an established price the margin over the $110 cost and the reach toward $2,000 are not established.

alternatives.title: Sell at $150 anyway as a test
alternatives.why: Would rest on an unsourced price with only $40 margin per contract; the price must first be evidenced by what growers are published as paying.

steps.label: Find published almond-pollination hive rental prices paid by growers (figure or range, source and date) and confirm the per-contract price versus Valley Apiaries' $110 cost

quantities.name: price
quantities.needs: A published, dated price almond growers actually pay for this hive contract

sources.claim: 400 almond growers in the valley rent hives every February

noPlan.decisiveGap: OFFER_AND_PRICE: the $150 price is only a person's statement, so no evidenced price establishes the offer, its margin over the $110 fulfilment cost, or reach toward $2,000.
noPlan.resolution: Answer the open revenueRange question: record what almond growers are published as paying for pollination hive contracts (with source and date), or obtain written price acceptances from growers, then re-plan.
